name: Shiiba (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shiiba village emblem in white: a ring with a stylised tree and a pointed base.
history: Municipal flag of Shiiba, a village in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 November 1973.

features.role: Shiiba village emblem — a ring with a stylised tree and a pointed base
